notes: Openspec provided empty acceptanceCriteria with useful diagnostic notes about the defect location. I built the full AC list from scratch based on the defect description and the referenced files. Key additions: (1) primary fix AC for return-trip promo display, (2) regression guard for one-way trips, (3) null/zero discount edge case, (4) station-swapping isolation — since create-reservations.mappers.ts swaps stations for return trips, this AC ensures that transformation doesn't corrupt the discount, (5) percentage-based discount edge case — percentage promos may be miscalculated against one-way fare instead of return fare, (6) fixed-amount discount edge case — fixed promos may be dropped entirely or doubled, (7) end-to-end mapping verification from source data to sanitized dispatch. All ACs follow What-Not-How: they describe observable outcomes in the email/dispatch output, never naming implementation details like mock patterns or file internals.

notes: Defect: promo code discount amount displays incorrectly for return-trip tickets in Mozio email confirmations. Prior coordinator flagged that openspec produced no ACs (acceptanceChanged:false, splitCount:0) while speckit built the full AC set.
